transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I guess I'm just having some issues at work. I buy for a retail company, and... I don't know. I just can't shake this feeling that people there, and maybe some of the vendors too, are tracking what I buy. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor keeps showing me reports saying that's not happening, but... I just know they are.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to notice?

...I mean, I guess. Sometimes. Just... when I'm alone in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. 

I'll hear this guy's voice. It sounds like he's right behind me. He just tells me to move faster, like, move faster Scott... or he's laughing at my picks. But when I turn around to look, nobody is there.
How long have you been having these experiences?

...I don't know. A while, I guess. 

Maybe... ten months? Since all this started with the numbers and the voice. Roughly ten months.
Have you also had any periods of feeling unusually depressed or unusually energized, when these voices or beliefs were happening?

...I guess so. There were a few weeks where I was... pretty energized, I suppose. I was barely sleeping. Just... talking nonstop about sneaker trends at work. I felt... I don't know, kind of untouchable. 

But... yeah, even during all that, I was still sure the vendors were manipulating the numbers. And I'd still hear that voice... pushing me to move faster.
Have you ever had a period like that—feeling unusually energized or needing very little sleep—lasting for at least a week?

...Yeah, I mean... I guess so. Most of the time, really. 

Since all this started... looking back, it feels like most of it has been spent like that. Just... wired, you know? Or irritable. Overworking, feeling like I knew better than everyone else... hard to slow down. The calm periods between all that... they've been pretty short.
Have there been times when the voice or the belief about people tracking you continued even when you were not feeling wired or energized?

...Yeah. I guess there was a time. 

Things were... quieter, I suppose. I was actually sleeping, not feeling like I had to run the whole market. But... I still thought they were tracking my buys. And... I still heard the voice when I was in the stockroom. That went on for a few weeks, even when I wasn't feeling so wired.
Have there been times when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, but you were not feeling unusually energized or down at all?

...Yeah. Like I just said... there was that time. 

I wasn't wired. I was sleeping okay... I didn't feel like I had to control everything. It was just a calmer stretch. But... yeah. For a few weeks then, I still thought they were watching my buys. And the voice was still there in the stockroom. So... yes.
Since these problems started, have there been times when your mood was back to normal but the voice or tracking beliefs were still there for at least two weeks?

...I thought I just answered that. 

Yeah. It was like I said. I was calmer... sleeping fine. Not trying to do everything at work. But for a few weeks during that time... I still thought they were watching my purchases. And the voice in the stockroom didn't stop. So, yes. At least two weeks.
Have the tracking beliefs or the voice been present on and off for a total of at least six months since they started?
...Yeah. I guess it's been a while. Maybe... ten months or so. Since it all started.
Have there been times when the voices or tracking beliefs were completely absent for at least two weeks while your mood symptoms were still going on?
...No. I don't think so. It's... it's pretty much always there in the background. Even when I'm feeling really wired or whatever, the voice is still around. I don't think it ever just... stops.
Have there been any times when the voices or tracking beliefs continued for at least two weeks while you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

...Didn't you just ask me this? 

I... yeah. Like I said before. There was that time I was calmer. Sleeping okay, not trying to run the whole market. But... for a few weeks then, I still thought they were tracking my buys. And the voice in the stockroom was still there. So... yeah.
Have you ever had at least two weeks when the voice or the belief that people were tracking you was present while you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

...You literally just asked me that. 

Yeah. Same as what I just told you.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you had no hallucinations or fixed false beliefs at all?

...No. Not that I can remember. 

Like I said... it's pretty much always there. I don't really get a break from it. So... no.
Since these symptoms started, have there been times when you were having the mood symptoms but not the voice or tracking beliefs?

...No. Not really. 

Even when I was... really wired. Like, those weeks I was barely sleeping, just talking nonstop about sneaker trends... feeling untouchable at work. Even then, I was still convinced the vendors were manipulating the numbers. And I still heard that voice... pushing me to move faster. 

So... no. They were both happening.
Have you noticed a lasting decline in your work, relationships, or self-care since these symptoms began?

...Yeah. I guess so. 

Work's been... bad. I missed some buying deadlines. Messed up things with a few vendors. Made some stupid calls on purchases, and... my boss gave me a formal warning. 

And I don't really see anyone anymore. I used to go to gallery nights, play volleyball on the weekends... I just stopped showing up. I just stay home now.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt abnormally high or irritable and more energized than usual?

...Yeah. I guess there are times like that. 

I get these... stretches, I guess. Where I just feel like the whole city is opening up for me. Like everything's just... clear. 

But then... if someone questions a purchase order at work, or tells me I need to slow down... I just snap. Way harder than I mean to. 

So... yeah. I get like that.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, but you were not feeling unusually energized, irritable, or depressed at all?

...Yeah. There was a time like that. 

Things were... quieter, I guess. I was sleeping okay. I didn't feel like I was running everything. 

But... I still thought they were tracking my buys. And... I still heard that voice when I was in the stockroom. That went on for a few weeks, even when I wasn't feeling so wired.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the voice or the belief that people were tracking you was present while you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

...Didn't you just ask me that? 

I... I already said yes. There was that time. A few weeks. I was sleeping fine, not feeling... wired or anything. But the voice was still there. And I still knew they were watching my accounts. 

So... yeah. Same answer.
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, but you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

...I don't know why we keep going over this. 

Yes. Like I said. There was a calmer stretch. I was sleeping more normally. I didn't feel like I was running the whole market or anything. 

But I still spent a few weeks knowing they were tracking my buys. And... I still heard the voice in the stockroom. 

I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when your mood was abnormally elevated or irritable most of the day nearly every day?

...Yeah. I guess so. 

Sometimes I get these... stretches. Where it feels like the whole city is just opening up for me. Like everything is clicking. 

But then... if someone at work questions one of my purchase orders, or tells me I need to slow down... I get mad. I snap at them. Way harder than I mean to. 

So, yeah. That happens.
